bbox_margin_note: About 5.5 km on every side of the study-area geometry bounds, so near-boundary jetties and route endpoints are not clipped.

overpass.status_note: Attempted 2026-10-24 on overpass.private.coffee and overpass.kumi.systems; both timed out or returned dispatcher errors on a trivial query, so the Geofabrik extract is the OSM source. overpass-api.de was not used because its robots.txt disallows /api/.

island_assignment.note: Inside an island polygon = 'within_polygon'. Otherwise the nearest island polygon boundary within offshore_max_distance_m = 'nearest_shoreline'. Beyond that no island is assigned. Centroids are never used.

ferry_match.note: Methods: island_name (assigned island equals stop island, atoll agrees; blank-atoll Male-area stops accept Greater_Male or K), island_alias (table above), feature_name_token (feature name contains the island name, never for route endpoints, and never when it contradicts the assigned island).
ferry_match.alias_note: Ferry sheets print Villimale/Vilimale for the Male-city island OneMap calls Vilin'gili (data/manual/ferry/stop_name_aliases.csv already treats villimale=vilimale). Needs local confirmation.

grouping.note: Two features join one group when within distance_m and: both named with name similarity >= name_similarity_min; or exactly one is unnamed; or both are unnamed AND from different sources. Unnamed features from the same source never chain to each other (avoids merging whole resort jetty networks). Single linkage; every source row is kept.

confidence_rules.high: named ferry_terminal/ferry platform/stop_position or harbour polygon with an island assigned within polygon or <=100 m
confidence_rules.medium: other harbour-related classes with an island assigned
confidence_rules.low: route endpoint evidence, unassigned island, or generic structure (breakwater, quay) without a name
